description: Track I: generic greedy means-ends solving of SolveTasks with a domain's held and invented processes; impasses are left for invention and wall explanation.

microtheory.name: process_solving
microtheory.description: Use the process that brings the state closest to the goal; stop when none helps.

rules.name: sv_greedy_step
rules.comment: Apply the domain process that most reduces Hamming distance to the goal (cheapest on ties), only if it strictly reduces it. One step per pass per task.

rules.name: sv_solved
rules.comment: A task whose state equals its goal is solved.

rules.name: sv_stuck
rules.comment: Impasse: no process in the domain reduces the distance (or the step bound is hit). Record how many processes the task has seen so it can retry when the library grows.

rules.name: sv_retry_when_library_grows
rules.comment: A stuck task retries once the domain holds more active processes than it last saw.
